title: JLOS Reservation Item
description: Data contract for one restaurant Reservation Item in the JLOS v4.0 Alpha Reservation Timeline.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the Reservation Item.

dayNumber.description: One-based itinerary day used to group the timeline.

date.description: Reservation date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

itemType.description: Module discriminator. v4.0 Alpha supports restaurant only; future values are documented separately.

meal.description: Meal period for the restaurant reservation.

time.description: Local reservation time using 24-hour HH:mm format.

title.description: Compact operator-facing label for the timeline entry.

confirmationNumber.description: Supplier confirmation or booking reference. Null or an empty string means not supplied.

phone.description: Restaurant phone number. Null means not supplied.

contact.description: Restaurant contact person or team. Null means not supplied.

locationLink.description: Google Maps or restaurant location URL. Null means not supplied. Physical address is not part of this model.

guides.description: Number of guides included in the reservation.

menu.description: Structured menu summary for the current reservation.

name.description: Menu or course name. Null means undecided.

pricePerGuest.description: Menu price per guest. Null means not supplied.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Null means not supplied.

items.description: Ordered list of included dishes or services.

notes.description: Operator notes, dietary requirements, or service instructions. Empty string means no notes.

image.description: Primary reference image URL. Null means no image.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Most recent update timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format.
